packs: strings

=== str-len
(str-len "abc")
--- want
3

=== str-len counts runes
(str-len "héllo")
--- want
5

=== str-len empty
(str-len "")
--- want
0

=== str-concat
(str-concat "a" "b" "c")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-concat needs strings
(str-concat "a" 1)
--- error

=== str-join
(str-join "-" (list "a" "b"))
--- want
"a-b"

=== str-join empty list
(str-join "-" (list))
--- want
""

=== str-split
(str-split "," "a,b")
--- want
(list "a" "b")

=== str-split no separator present
(str-split "," "abc")
--- want
(list "abc")

=== str-find present
(str-find "foo" "foobar")
--- want
#t

=== str-find absent
(str-find "baz" "foobar")
--- want
#f

=== str-sub
(str-sub "héllo" 1 3)
--- want
"él"

=== str-sub to end
(str-sub "hello" 3)
--- want
"lo"

=== str-replace
(str-replace "l" "L" "hello")
--- want
"heLLo"

=== str-trim
(str-trim "  hi  ")
--- want
"hi"

=== str-upper
(str-upper "abc")
--- want
"ABC"

=== str-lower
(str-lower "ABC")
--- want
"abc"

=== str-fmt string
(str-fmt "%s!" "hi")
--- want
"hi!"

=== str-fmt float
(str-fmt "%.2f" 3.14159)
--- want
"3.14"

=== str-fmt %d
(str-fmt "%d" 1)
--- want
"1"

=== str-fmt %d with width
(str-fmt "[%3d]" 7)
--- want
"[  7]"

=== str-fmt %d zero padded
(str-fmt "%03d" 7)
--- want
"007"

=== str-fmt %d rejects a fraction
(str-fmt "%d" 1.5)
--- error

=== str-fmt %d rejects a string
(str-fmt "%d" "1")
--- error

=== str-fmt %s renders any value as text
(str-fmt "%s %s %s" 42 #t "x")
--- want
"42 #t x"

=== str-fmt %v renders a Filo literal
(str-fmt "%v" (list 1 "a"))
--- want
"(list 1 \"a\")"

=== str-fmt left-aligned width
(str-fmt "[%-4s]" "ab")
--- want
"[ab  ]"

=== str-fmt percent sign
(str-fmt "100%%")
--- want
"100%"

=== str-fmt unknown verb is an error
(str-fmt "%x" 1)
--- error

=== str-fmt incomplete verb is an error
(str-fmt "50%")
--- error

=== str-fmt missing argument is an error
(str-fmt "%s %s" "a")
--- error

=== str-fmt extra argument is an error
(str-fmt "%s" "a" "b")
--- error

=== str-fmt format must be a string
(str-fmt 1)
--- error

=== str-upper maps Latin-1 letters
(str-upper "ação é ÿ")
--- want
"AÇÃO É Ÿ"

=== str-lower maps Latin-1 letters
(str-lower "AÇÃO É Ÿ")
--- want
"ação é ÿ"

=== str-upper leaves other scripts alone
(str-upper "日本 ß")
--- want
"日本 ß"

=== str-split with an empty separator explodes into runes
(str-split "" "héy")
--- want
(list "h" "é" "y")

=== str-split of an empty string by an empty separator is empty
(str-split "" "")
--- want
(list)

=== str-split of an empty string
(str-split "," "")
--- want
(list "")

=== str-split keeps empty fields
(str-split "," ",a,,b,")
--- want
(list "" "a" "" "b" "")

=== str-replace with an empty old inserts everywhere
(str-replace "" "-" "ab")
--- want
"-a-b-"

=== str-replace removes
(str-replace "l" "" "hello")
--- want
"heo"

=== str-sub clamps
(str-sub "hello" -3 100)
--- want
"hello"

=== str-sub with a negative end means the end
(str-sub "hello" 1 -1)
--- want
"ello"

=== str-sub start past end is empty
(str-sub "hello" 4 2)
--- want
""

=== str-sub rejects a fractional start
(str-sub "hello" 1.5)
--- error

=== str-trim removes a no-break space
(str-trim "  hi  ")
--- want
"hi"

=== str-find empty substring
(str-find "" "abc")
--- want
#t

=== str-join needs string elements
(str-join "-" (list "a" 1))
--- error

=== str-len of a multibyte string
(str-len "日本語")
--- want
3

=== str-fmt %+d
(str-fmt "%+d %+d" 5 -5)
--- want
"+5 -5"

=== str-fmt %d precision pads digits
(str-fmt "%.3d" 7)
--- want
"007"

=== str-fmt %d precision wins over zero flag
(str-fmt "%05.3d" 7)
--- want
"  007"

=== str-fmt %-5d
(str-fmt "[%-5d]" 42)
--- want
"[42   ]"

=== str-fmt %d negative zero padded
(str-fmt "%05d" -42)
--- want
"-0042"

=== str-fmt %f default precision
(str-fmt "%f" 1.5)
--- want
"1.500000"

=== str-fmt %8.2f
(str-fmt "[%8.2f]" 3.14159)
--- want
"[    3.14]"

=== str-fmt %+.1f
(str-fmt "%+.1f" 2)
--- want
"+2.0"

=== str-fmt %s precision truncates runes
(str-fmt "%.2s" "héllo")
--- want
"hé"

=== str-fmt width counts runes
(str-fmt "[%4s]" "é")
--- want
"[   é]"

=== str-fmt %v quotes a string
(str-fmt "%v" "a")
--- want
"\"a\""

=== str-fmt %s of a list
(str-fmt "%s" (list 1 2))
--- want
"(list 1 2)"

=== str-fmt %d of a fraction in text
(str-fmt "%d" 2.5)
--- error

=== str-fmt bad verb shape is an error
(str-fmt "%1-d" 1)
--- error
